description: This file declares functions and macros for quoting strings safely for shell and programming language contexts, such as shell commands, C strings, Perl, Python, and Tcl. It appears to be part of a quote handling utility in a larger project.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string buffer for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an argument vector for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats and quotes a string with printf-style arguments.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Quotes a string for human-readable display, avoiding exotic characters.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Quotes argument vector for human-readable display.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends argument vector quotes to an existing string buffer for human readability.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Dequotes a string produced by sq_quote, if possible.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a single quoted item, advancing to next token.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Splits and dequotes a string into argument vector.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes a string and stores tokens in a strvec.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Dequotes a C-style quoted string.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string in C-style, suitable for C code.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings in C-style, possibly for comparison or paired output.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a quoted name to a file, with terminator.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a quoted name relative to a prefix.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path relative to a given prefix for safe use in shell.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for Perl string literal.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for Perl with specified length.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for Python string literal.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for Tcl string literal.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for use in a basic regular expression.
